EvidencePolicy: SourceEvidence preserves historical reports and outcomes; it establishes names/provenance, not a current WP6 pass. Never sum repeated runs. Current verification requires exact names, all passed, and the caller-supplied actual process exit code zero.

CommandContract.Trx: CaseCommand supplies explicit --filter tokens; the runner supplies dotnet test, project and fresh TRX output path.
CommandContract.NativeMigration: CaseCommand supplies mode tokens; the runner adds --provider, --output and --source-sha.
CommandContract.NativeRuntime: CaseCommand supplies --suite/--case/--initialize; the runner adds --provider, --output and --source-sha.
CommandContract.IdentityChecks: CaseCommand is the complete positional argument vector after the fixture binary. ResultPath is PublicOutputDirectory/summary.json.
CommandContract.ApplicationChecks: CaseCommand begins with the positional command and supplies command arguments. The runner appends --provider and --report. State remains private; public report DatabaseName must equal the receipt target.
CommandContract.MigrationSeedState: Seed prepare/verify uses {SeedStatePath} on the same application database; final capture uses distinct {CapturedSeedStatePath}. Cross-database restore uses ApplicationChecks restore-state-verify, never legacy seed verify.
CommandContract.SignalR: Only application-signalr-user-delivery accepts literal-loopback BaseUri, SignalREventKey and its three exact credential environment keys. No credentials occur in argument tokens or public reports.
